subject: Request: Executive approval for 25% concession on Hosted API renewal — Lifescribe
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex White <alex.white@lifescribe.ai>, Susan Lawson <susan.lawson@lifescribe.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal + request for flexibility

Hi Alex / Susan,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Based on Lifescribe's projected Hosted API consumption (see attached usage export), we put together a renewal proposal that locks current rates but includes a predictable monthly commit to avoid surprises during your ramp.

Summary: 12-month term, estimated monthly tokens ~1.2B, list discount tiered starting at 18%. Your procurement asked whether we can do a deeper concession to match the budgets you shared.

Attachment: Lifescribe_MonthlyUsage_202609.csv (csv)
Attachment: Deal_Summary_Lifescribe.pdf (pdf)

Ben, Mina — looping you in because Lifescribe is asking for a further discount beyond standard authorized thresholds (they're requesting 25% off list). Can you advise next steps for exec approval? I included a short margin analysis in the PDF.

Alex / Susan — can you confirm the committed monthly token target and whether you need a multi-region SLA? Those two items materially affect pricing.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0122

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Alex White <alex.white@lifescribe.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + request for flexibility

David — thanks for the packet, appreciate the quick turnaround.

We reviewed projections with finance. Lifescribe can commit to the 1.2B tokens/mo for 12 months but our budget only supports a max blended unit rate that implies ~25% off your published Hosted API list. For us this is about keeping unit economics predictable while we finish the integration.

Also: we will need EU region availability for a small subset of traffic (about 8% of volume) and standard SOC-2 evidence. If you can do 25% and include EU-region routing capability, we can sign within 72 hours.

Procurement contact: Susan Lawson (copied).

Best,
Alex
Alex White
Head of Platform, Lifescribe
alex.white@lifescribe.ai | +44 20 7946 0820
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 07:18:00 -07:00
Subject: FWD: Lifescribe — exec approval request (25% + EU region)

Ben / Mina — forwarding Lifescribe's ask. Key points: 1. 1.2B tokens/mo committed for 12 months; 2. Asking for 25% off list (our threshold for senior approval); 3. Needs EU routing for ~8% of traffic; 4. SOC2 evidence requested (we can supply).

Impact: at current list, 25% reduces expected ARR from $4.3M to ~$3.225M (annualized). We've modeled cost with our expected batching/quantization benefits and still show ~18% gross margin at that concession level assuming steady-state optimizations. I've attached Deal_Summary_Lifescribe.pdf with the numbers and a short draft concession term sheet (Terms_Concession_Proposal.docx).

If we can get a one-time exec authorization for 25% for 12 months (with a 3-month review and usage guardrails + commitment to a quarterly business review), we can close quickly and keep Lifescribe on Hosted (instead of them building a private deployment). I recommend: approve 25% for a 12-month term conditioned on documented monthly commits, EU routing limited to our EU POP (no dedicated private deployment), and SOC2 provided within 10 business days post-signature.

Can you confirm whether senior can sign off and if we should limit to a six-month pilot instead to reduce risk?

Thanks,
David
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: Lifescribe — exec approval request (25% + EU region)

David — thanks for the packet and the clear recommendation. A couple quick asks before I escalate to execs:

- Confirmed blended unit economics at 25% (you included one scenario but please add a conservative case with 10% less batching).
- Legal to draft a limited concession clause: 25% for 12 months OR until usage exceeds committed tokens by 20% (at which point pricing reverts to list).
- Include a success metric for the 3-month review (e.g., customer stays within +/-10% of committed usage).

Mina — if you're comfortable with the margin sensitivity, I'm prepared to present this to finance and request senior pricing sign-off. If exec wants to mitigate, propose doing 25% only for first six months then revisit.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0188
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: Lifescribe — exec approval request (25% + EU region)

Thanks — reviewed the conservative scenario Ben requested. With 10% lower batching the gross margin drops to ~12% but remains positive. Given the strategic upside (integration into Lifescribe's clinical workflows and potential expansion across EU customers), I will provisionally approve the 25% hosted API concession for an initial six-month period subject to:

1) Signed 12-month commitment in contract with a guaranteed minimum monthly spend (1.2B tokens/mo).
2) Concession limited to the first 6 months (months 7-12 revert to standard pricing or re-negotiated).
3) EU routing provided via our EU POP (no private appliance; any additional compliance requirements billed separately).
4) SOC2 evidence delivered within 10 business days post-signature.

If procurement accepts those conditions, David — you have my provisional sign-off to proceed and finalize the concession paperwork with Legal. Ben — please include the limited concession clause in the draft.

Mina
Mina Haddad
VP, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex White <alex.white@lifescribe.ai>, Susan Lawson <susan.lawson@lifescribe.ai>, procurement@lifescribe.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Lifescribe concession terms — confirmation and next steps

Alex / Susan — great news: Redwood can provisionally grant the 25% concession under the conditions Mina outlined below. Summary of final terms: 

- Concession: 25% off Hosted API list prices applied for first 6 months following signature.
- Commitment: 12-month contract; minimum 1.2B tokens/month guaranteed.
- Review: 90-day business review with usage and performance metrics; if committed thresholds exceeded by >20% during concession, pricing reverts to list for overage.
- EU: Traffic can be routed via our EU POP for up to 8% of volume; any additional regional compliance work is out-of-scope and billable.
- Evidence: SOC2 Type II package to be provided within 10 business days after signature.

Action items: please confirm acceptance by replying and we will send the updated contract (DocuSign link below). Once signed we will provision EU routing and schedule the QBR.

DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.com/LS-2026-0891
Attachment: Terms_Concession_Proposal.docx (docx)

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week.
David
From: Alex White <alex.white@lifescribe.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Susan Lawson <susan.lawson@lifescribe.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lifescribe concession terms — confirmation and next steps

David — confirmed, Lifescribe accepts the concession terms as written. Susan will countersign and route to procurement for DocuSign today. Appreciate the flexibility — excited to get started.

Alex
